campingAndFire.summary: No intermediate indoor cabins exist between Somashytta and Saraelv/Ovi. Wild camping is the practical fallback, but field reports show good campsites are unevenly distributed: Coalbmejávrrit and Sarafossen plateau are useful camping clues, while later slope/forest sections can be damp, steep, dense or hard to camp in. Norway's general woodland fire ban runs 15 April-15 September, and Ovi Raishiin fire sites still require fire-ban/common-sense caveats.
shelterAndCampingNotes: Reisa official trail page explicitly says there are no cabins on this section.
E1 mentions a marked detour to a designated campsite at the upper end of Sarafossen.
In the Woods, Dear reports good tenting/fireplace context at Somashytta and a planned Sarafossen plateau campsite, but scarce campsites after Coalbmejávrrit and on later damp/steep ground.
Hikeouts 2024 and MyWanderfulLife 2022 used Nordkalottstua/Ovi as an endpoint lodging option, but booking/phone/code was needed.
No import-ready intermediate campsite coordinate was found in official/OSM data.
fireRules: Norway has a general fire ban in or near woodland from 15 April to 15 September.
Reisa guidance says fires may be lit with care, fallen wood should be used considerately, and no burning fire should be left.
Ovi Raishiin has official campfire sites, but these should still inherit national/local fire-ban caveats.

dogRules.summary: Dogs must be on leash from 1 April to 20 August; local leash rules may be stricter. Reindeer grazing/calving/breeding sensitivity is specifically relevant.

fireRules.summary: General Norwegian fire ban in woodland from 15 April to 15 September. Fires require caution outside that period and at Ovi's campfire sites.

huntingFishing.summary: Fishing and hunting are allowed only in season with licences/permits. Reisaelva fishing is managed separately; Somájávri fishing is mentioned by Reisa cabin page but requires permit context.

currentnessAndHazards.details: Ráhpesjohka, Meahccejohka and multiple smaller streams/OSM fords can be easy in low water but serious after rain or snowmelt. Field reports from 2017 and 2022 describe above-knee/high crossings, wet terrain and poor-weather exposure.
Official Sarafossen material and field reports describe a steep descent, slippery rock/scree in rain and no safety structures at gorge viewpoints. Treat as safety note, not just scenic attraction.

Rules lane checked NVE/Varsom on 2026-04-29: Nord-Troms avalanche danger was level 2 for Apr 29, level 3 for Apr 30 and level 2 for May 1. This is time-sensitive winter/spring context only and should not be stored as a static closure.
currentnessAndHazards.confidence: high for 2026-04-29 check; low as persistent route data

currentnessAndHazards.details: No official section-specific summer closure or reroute was found in checked Reisa NP, Nordreisa, Statskog/Fjelltjenesten, MET, DSB or Varsom sources as of 2026-04-29.

researchIterations.type: six-agent parallel research plus local synthesis

lanes.summary: Confirmed Reisa 31 km section, no intermediate cabins, Ovi/Saraelv endpoint ambiguity, Somashytta and Nordkalottstua official facility context, access and rule sources.
Identified OSM relation 9517991, E1 GPX, endpoint gaps, Ovi connector length and ford/bridge clues.
Confirmed Somashytta, Ovi Raishiin/Nordkalottstua, Ovi toilets/parking/viewpoint, Saraelv lodging and negative evidence for intermediate shelters.
Researched Guolasjávri/Kilpisjärvi/Saraelv/Ovi/Storslett/Svartfoss access, with clear distinction between public transit, private transfers and seasonal road logistics.
Synthesized 2012-2025 reports for weather, high traverse, fords, Sarafossen descent, Ovi/Nordkalottstua access and no 2026 firsthand report.
Confirmed Ráisduottarháldi/Reisa rules context, fire/dog/reindeer/hunting/fishing policy, current snow/avalanche/flood checks and no found section-specific closure.

researchIterations.synthesisDecision: Research-complete at candidate level. No second targeted batch needed before moving to section 8 because main unresolved items are normalization/import policy issues rather than discoverable section facts.

openQuestions: Decide whether the normalized section endpoint is Saraelv route endpoint, Ovi Raishiin/Nordkalottstua, or a compound endpoint with a connector.
